title: Prefetch Manifest
description: Ordered list of media assets to pre-cache before an upcoming workout session, plus the manifest-level metadata needed by the background prefetch workers on Android (VideoPrefetchWorker, CoroutineWorker constrained to NetworkType.UNMETERED) and iOS (VideoPrefetchManager actor driven by BGTaskScheduler). The worker downloads every listed asset into the LRU VideoCacheManager over Wi-Fi only. The canonical cache key for each asset URL is the SHA-256 hex digest of the URL (see cdn_asset_schema.json). Manifests are produced by the WorkoutGenerator when it produces a session, and only contain assets for exercises actually scheduled in that session.

manifest_id.description: Stable SHA-256 (hex lowercase) digest of the session_id, identifying this prefetch workload uniquely for idempotency and deduplication in BGTaskScheduler / WorkManager queues.

session_id.description: Foreign key to the workout_sessions.id whose exercises should be pre-cached. UUID-formatted as emitted by the workout session store.

user_id.description: Owning user id, used for per-user prefetch quotas.

created_at_epoch_seconds.description: Unix epoch seconds the manifest was generated. Workers use this to skip stale manifests (default staleness threshold 24h).

assets.description: Ordered list of assets to prefetch. Videos are listed before their companion SVG so the network-order worker prefers the heavier, gameplay-critical mp4 first.

network_constraint.description: Hard requirement that prefetch only run over Wi-Fi / unmetered networks. Maps directly to Android WorkRequest NetworkType.UNMETERED and the iOS nw_path_monitor isExpensive==false gate.

priority.description: WorkManager expedited-priority hint and BGTaskScheduler urgency hint. Scheduled session prefetch is DEFAULT; user-tapped 'Cache now' is HIGH.

asset_type.description: Asset kind. VIDEO assets are downloaded to the LRU video cache; SVG assets are also cached but additionally bundled in-app as offline fallback.

url.description: Absolute CDN URL of the asset (matches the video_path_template or svg_path_template in cdn_asset_schema.json).

cache_key.description: Precomputed SHA-256 hex lowercase digest of url. The same key the on-device VideoCacheManager uses for its LRU file name and eviction index. Precomputed so the worker can do an O(1) existence check without hashing on the prefetch thread.

file_size_bytes.description: Expected byte length from cdn_asset_schema.json. Workers verify the downloaded file size matches; mismatches trigger a re-download and bump attempt_count.

required.description: If false the asset is optional (e.g. secondary SVG variants) and the worker must not fail the whole manifest if it 404s. Default true for video assets.
